title: etbb-july-2024-may-2025-update.pdf — section 42
text:
94. Basic conventions and rules need to be stated at the start of a hearing by the judge:
• Introduce those present. Explain their roles, and how the judge should be addressed.
• Explain the procedure and timing of the day.
• Ensure mobile phones are switched off.
Litigants in person and lay representatives
Equal Treatment Bench Book – July 2024 (May 2025 update) 19
• Inform the LIP that they should ask for clarification if anything is unclear and request
breaks if they require them.
• Clearly state the purpose of the hearing and issue(s) to be decided.
• Explain that a party may take notes, but the law forbids the making of audio or video
recordings (without the express consent of the judge).
• Only one person may speak at a time. Each side will have a full opportunity to present its
case.
